deprecated_yaml.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed.

Your existing YAML configuration has been imported into the UI automatically.

The `tts.{domain}_say` action will be removed. Update your automations to use the `tts.speak` action with the new text-to-speech entity, then remove the `{domain}` platform from your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
deprecated_yaml.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration is being removed

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed, but importing your YAML configuration failed because Amazon Polly could not be reached.

Add {integration_title} from the UI, then remove the `{domain}` platform from your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.title: [%key:component::amazon_polly::issues::deprecated_yaml::title%]

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_credentials.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed. Your YAML configuration uses an AWS profile or the default AWS credentials, which cannot be imported automatically.

Add {integration_title} from the UI with an IAM access key, then remove the `{domain}` platform from your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_credentials.title: [%key:component::amazon_polly::issues::deprecated_yaml::title%]

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed, but importing your YAML configuration failed because AWS rejected the access key.

Add {integration_title} from the UI with a valid access key, then remove the `{domain}` platform from your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.title: [%key:component::amazon_polly::issues::deprecated_yaml::title%]

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed, but importing your YAML configuration failed with an unexpected error.

Add {integration_title} from the UI, then remove the `{domain}` platform from your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.title: [%key:component::amazon_polly::issues::deprecated_yaml::title%]
